title: Private Party vs. the Bucks: from upset to champions
summary: Private Party’s early victory over the Young Bucks is followed years later by a championship breakthrough.

chapters.title: Private Party shock the Bucks
chapters.result: Private Party eliminate the Bucks from the tag-title tournament.
chapters.context: The upset establishes the young team.

chapters.title: The championship breakthrough
chapters.result: Private Party defeat the Bucks for their first AEW tag titles.
chapters.context: They finally convert promise into championship success.
